put.description:
Performs an action on a running Training Cluster. The `action` field in the request body determines the operation. Additional fields are required depending on the action:

| Action | Required Fields | Description |
|--------|----------------|-------------|
| `update_ssh_keys` | `ssh_key_ids` | Replace SSH keys on all cluster nodes |
| `update_image` | `image_version_id` | Update the container image on all cluster nodes |
| `restart_workers` | — | Restart all compute (worker) nodes without restarting the Slurm controller |
| `restart_cluster` | — | Restart the full cluster including the Slurm controller and all nodes |
| `scale_cluster` | `additional_nodes` | Add nodes to a running cluster without teardown or workload disruption |
| `attach_ip` | `reserved_ip_id` | Attach a reserved public IP to the cluster. Returns a Reserved IP object instead of a cluster object. |
| `detach_ip` | `reserved_ip_id`, `ip_type` | Detach a reserved public IP from the cluster. Returns an empty data object. |
| `add_security_group` | `security_groups_ids` | Attach one or more security groups to the cluster. Returns a success string. |
| `remove_security_group` | `security_group_id` | Remove a security group from the cluster. Returns a success string. |

parameters.name: active_iam
parameters.description: Active IAM ID **(To access contact person account)** [**Find your Active IAM ID here**](/paths/users-iam-accounts/get)

action.description: Action to perform on the cluster. Each action may require additional fields.

ssh_key_ids.description: Required for `update_ssh_keys`. List of SSH key IDs to attach to all cluster nodes.

image_version_id.description: Required for `update_image`. ID of the image version to apply to all cluster nodes.

additional_nodes.description: Required for `scale_cluster`. Number of nodes to add to the running cluster.

reserved_ip_id.description: Required for `attach_ip` and `detach_ip`. ID of the reserved IP.

ip_type.description: Required for `detach_ip`. Type of IP being detached.

security_groups_ids.description: Required for `add_security_group`. List of security group IDs to attach to the cluster.

security_group_id.description: Required for `remove_security_group`. ID of the security group to remove from the cluster.

200.description: Action performed successfully. Returns the updated cluster object.
